name: Berserk: Guts’ road
description: Two roads lie before you. Begin before the Eclipse, with a long sword and worn leather, to seek the Behelit yourself. Or take up the road afterward as the Branded swordsman, with the Dragonslayer and the cursed armor. For the full story, choose Guts before the Eclipse in a fresh world; this start does not undo an Eclipse the world has already seen.
